Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

CM APPL. 26754/2023 (delay 42 days)
3. This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 42 days delay in re-filing the appeal.
4. The application is, for the reasons stated therein, allowed and consequently, the delay of 42 days in re-filing the appeal stands condoned.
5. The application stands disposed of.

6. The present appeal preferred by the owner of the offending vehicle under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, seeks to assail the award dated 12.01.2023 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal.
Vide the impugned award, the appellant has been directed to

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that despite it being evident that the respondent is not suffering from any disability and is continuing with his earlier job, the learned Tribunal has accepted the disability certificate tendered by the respondent without any other evidence being led in this regard.
8. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondent through all permissible modes.
9. In the meanwhile, let the TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.

CM APPL. 26753/2023 (stay)
11.This is an application filed by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

12.The application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit, within eight weeks, 50% of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of the claimants as per the scheme of disbursal contained in the impugned award.
13.Subject to the appellant depositing the amount in terms of this order, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal.
14.The application stands disposed of.
